integrity: Proof is analytic. A standalone standard-library rational checker supplies finite reproducibility checks. No independent audit is claimed.
limitations: Exactly two scalar strictly convex quadratic components, exactly one two-step epoch, common fixed step, independent sampling models; general-curvature comparison starts at the finite-sum minimizer; all-start comparison assumes equal curvatures. No claims on all algorithms, long-run rates, or machine precision.
title: A sharp one-epoch variance-reversal threshold for two-component random reshuffling
